committee_memo.thesis: NVIDIA (NVDA) is a strong buy at current prices given its AI infrastructure monopoly and data center revenue trajectory
key_insights: CUDA ecosystem creates a multi-year switching-cost moat that no competitor can replicate in the 2026-2028 investment horizon
AI infrastructure capex is in year 2 of a durable 4-5 year cycle with $1T+ committed hyperscaler spend
Momentum technicals unambiguously confirm the bull thesis with institutional accumulation at record levels

risk_factors: Custom ASIC displacement risk (15-20% inference TAM erosion by 2027) from Google TPU, Amazon Trainium, Meta MTIA
